title: GBRG Blast-Radius Proof Artifact
description: Extends the canonical ProofArtifact with blast-radius fields. Every GBRG MCP tool returns this object (never a bare float).
$comment: Converged onto the estate-canonical ProofArtifact v1 (standards-storage#97, remediation R2): binds via allOf to https://schemas.socioprophet.ai/proof-artifact/v1.json and $refs its epistemicLevel enum from $defs instead of copy-pasting it. The canonical is sovereign-vendored at contracts/vendor/proof-artifact/proof-artifact.schema.v1.json. `synthetic` (proof-confidence over DATA) stays distinct from the separate top-level `generated` boolean (codegen); see the `generated` $comment and docs/ADR-001.

dependents_count.description: Direct dependents = in-degree of the cell in the frozen index.

test_coverage_reach.description: True if at least one test reaches this cell (incoming TESTED_BY edge).

churn_frequency.description: Historical change frequency of the cell (unnormalised count/rate).

blast_radius.$comment: Numeric scale is a 0.0-1.0 FLOAT so it can feed SCOPE-D's computeRiskScore directly. See docs/ADR-001.

derivation.description: Human-readable explanation of WHY this artifact holds (which cells/edges/tests were considered).

declared_by.description: Producing agent identity, resolvable in the agent-registry.

generated.$comment: True if the underlying cell is machine-generated (codegen). Kept SEPARATE from epistemicLevel 'synthetic' on purpose — see the canonical epistemicLevel $defs and docs/ADR-001.
